brief:
Israel's foreign minister said Wednesday the government has no plans to deport Palestinians from Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. Gideon Saar's statement came after two Israeli ministers proposed mass removal of Palestinians from the territory earlier this month, drawing international concern over potential forced displacement.

The denial reflects competing positions within Israel's cabinet on Gaza's future. Multiple government officials have offered differing visions for Palestinian civilians remaining in the enclave, with some proposing relocation and others rejecting the idea outright. Saar's public clarification addressed the proposals circulating among his colleagues in recent weeks.
